    actually use. Pin the finished runbook in the repository before you leave.

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Diagnosis block &mdash; the front door to step 1
      <span class="ws-block-note">tick your way through during a live recovery</span></h2>

    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup>
        <col style="width:6%"><col style="width:16%"><col style="width:40%"><col style="width:38%">
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr><th></th><th>Field</th><th>What the book says</th><th>Your answer</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">8</span></td>
          <td><b>D1 &middot; Which anti-pattern from the taxonomy</b></td>
          <td class="prior" style="font-size:6.6pt;line-height:1.25">
            1 Monolithic Prompt &mdash; all instructions in one block; small changes cascade.
            2 Context Dumping &mdash; everything loaded upfront.
            3 Unbounded Agent &mdash; no limits on tools or authority.
            4 Flat Instructions &mdash; same rules everywhere.
            5 Scope Creep &mdash; task grows mid-execution.
            6 The Solo Hero &mdash; one massive agent, no decomposition or review.
            7 The Trust Fall &mdash; output accepted without verification.
            8 Same-File Parallel Edits &mdash; second agent's changes fail silently.
            9 Skipping Checkpoints &mdash; waves committed without validation.
            10 Not Fixing the Primitives &mdash; symptoms corrected by hand.
            11 Context Window Exhaustion &mdash; earlier instructions silently dropped.
            12 Hallucinated Edits &mdash; success reported on changes not persisted.
            13 Stale Context Between Waves &mdash; wave N works against wave N-2 state.
            14 Cost Runaway &mdash; unbounded retries burn tokens.
            15 The "Almost Done" Trap &mdash; last 10% takes longer than starting over.
            16 Session State Loss &mdash; no checkpoint, unrecoverable work.
            17 Persona Drift &mdash; role shifts mid-session.
            18 Cross-Wave Merge Conflicts &mdash; pass individually, break together.
            19 Prompt Injection via Dependencies &mdash; external content hijacks the agent.
            <span class="prior-src">ch20 L20-38</span></td>
          <td class="fill">
            <div class="f-select"><span class="opt">1</span><span class="opt">2</span><span class="opt">3</span><span class="opt">4</span><span class="opt">5</span><span class="opt">6</span><span class="opt">7</span><span class="opt">8</span><span class="opt">9</span><span class="opt">10</span></div>
            <div class="f-select"><span class="opt">11</span><span class="opt">12</span><span class="opt">13</span><span class="opt">14</span><span class="opt">15</span><span class="opt">16</span><span class="opt">17</span><span class="opt">18</span><span class="opt">19</span></div>
          </td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">9</span></td>
          <td><b>D2 &middot; Syntax error?</b></td>
          <td class="prior">Yes routes to: model issue &mdash; upgrade or do it manually.<span class="prior-src">ch20 fig-failure-decision-tree</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-checkline"><span class="f-check"></span>yes</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>

          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">agent's</span><span class="opt">pre-existing</span><span class="opt">tests pass</span></div></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>

          <td class="prior">No routes to: architecture issue &mdash; fix boundaries. Yes routes to: probably fine &mdash; check edges.<span class="prior-src">ch20 fig-failure-decision-tree</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-checkline"><span class="f-check"></span>yes, it integrates</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>

Any mode that reaches no terminal, or only "probably fine: check edges", is a gap in the front door. Record each gap here: the mode number, and what the tree is missing.</p>
